name: Hanime1
notes: Test27 is a visible product/repair iteration on top of Test26. It restores more-replies with a single-request per-reply DOM parser and refuses to cache empty parse results, makes the author directory reliable by reusing the proven Provider.search(type=artist) path plus a recent-author landing state, and replaces the home five text tabs plus detail four text actions with repository-hosted SVG icon components. The cloud-repository installer is build-locked to 20027 so a re-import cannot silently stay on Test26/24.
